name: daily-weather-briefing
description: Fetch today's forecast from Open-Meteo (free, no API key) and turn it into a friendly chat message. Optionally send it to a chat channel.

city.description: Display name used in the message

notify_channel.description: Optional OpenClaw channel to send the message to (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...). Empty = just return it.

notify_target.description: Optional chat id / channel id for notify_channel

steps.run: node -e 'const f = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); const codes = { 0: "☀️ Clear sky", 1: "🌤️ Mainly clear", 2: "⛅ Partly cloudy", 3: "☁️ Overcast", 45: "🌫️ Fog", 48: "🌫️ Fog", 51: "🌦️ Light drizzle", 53: "🌦️ Drizzle", 55: "🌧️ Heavy drizzle", 61: "🌦️ Light rain", 63: "🌧️ Rain", 65: "🌧️ Heavy rain", 71: "🌨️ Light snow", 73: "🌨️ Snow", 75: "❄️ Heavy snow", 80: "🌦️ Rain showers", 81: "🌧️ Rain showers", 82: "⛈️ Violent showers", 95: "⛈️ Thunderstorm", 96: "⛈️ Thunderstorm with hail", 99: "⛈️ Thunderstorm with hail" }; const d = f.daily; const rain = d.precipitation_probability_max[0]; const lines = ["Good morning! Weather for " + process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_CITY + " today (" + d.time[0] + "):", codes[d.weather_code[0]] || "🌡️ Weather code " + d.weather_code[0], "🌡️ " + d.temperature_2m_min[0] + "°C – " + d.temperature_2m_max[0] + "°C (now " + f.current.temperature_2m + "°C)", "☔ Chance of rain: " + rain + "%", rain >= 50 ? "👉 Take an umbrella!" : "👉 No umbrella needed."]; console.log(lines.join("\n"))'

MSG=$(cat); if [ -n "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" ]; then openclaw message send --channel "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" --target "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$MSG" >&2; fi; printf '%s\n' "$MSG"
